newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police free Laotian from Vietnam kidnappers.
newsitem.headline: German police free Laotian from Vietnam kidnappers.

text.p: German police freed a five-year old Laotian girl unharmed in Berlin on Friday and detained four Vietnamese on suspicion of kidnapping her.

The girl was abducted on Tuesday from her home in the western town of Neuss, near Duesseldorf, by an armed gang which intitially held seven members of her family and demanded a ransom of tens of thousands of marks.

The gang then fled with the girl and a 36-year old woman. Police said the woman had also been found during the Berlin operation. Security sources said they were investigating the possibility that she was in league with the kidnappers.
Police said they believed the gang had been in Berlin for several days. The girl's mother had been ordered to come to the city with a ransom of 60,000 marks.
Police grabbed the Vietnamese kidnappers as they tried to collect the ransom near an underground railway station in the Lichtenberg district of the city.
